name: rings of marriage
text: A pair of magical rings made of silver. One of them has an amber gemstone inset, the other is a plain band. A creature can only attune to them by participating in the spell Ceremony. When a creature is attuned to them, they provide the following benefits: +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws, the creature is unharmed by cold temperatures.

name: Tablet of knowledge
text: This magical item enables the attuned creature to retrieve information or use the spell Sending by expending a charge. The item regenerates 5d6 charges at dawn. Each time it is used, there's a 1d100 chance the user will take 1d4 psychic damage.
